title: One-step predecessor for emission
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B$, and an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each of five deciders and each bit string. If the registers of a configuration $a$ are all at most $B$, and the configuration obtained by one step of the specified walk from $a$ satisfies the emission property for a segment $S$ starting at $k$ with postcondition $P$, then $a$ itself satisfies that emission property.
hypotheses_covered: Every register of $a$ is at most $B$.
The one-step successor of $a$ satisfies the emission property for $S$ with postcondition $P$.
